item.tib: las gshin sgrub gzhung gnam lcags thog mda'
item.coloph: de ltar gshin rje ya ma ra dza yi/ sgrab gzhung gnam lcags thog mda' bya ba 'di/ drin chen mtshungs med dam pa'i bka' nan dang / dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'dir/ bla ma yi dam rnams la mthol lo bshags/ mkha' 'gro bon skyong rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i (bas) 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
